summary: Request: per-role field allowlist forwarder with HSM-backed redaction and signed delivery receipts for audit evidence
description: Issue summary: NovaBank requests a near-real-time audit forwarder that enforces per-role field allowlisting, performs on-the-fly PII redaction using HSM-backed salts, and delivers cryptographically signed per-batch receipts for compliance evidence. They need a samplable evidence bundle and short answers to a security questionnaire covering key management and redaction proofs. Impact: This is a compliance blocker for a major production integration; customer cannot certify log delivery without per-event allowlist enforcement and signed receipts. Environment: Production tenant in us-east, delivering to customer's Graylog cluster over TLS. Desired delivery is RFC5425-style TLS syslog over mTLS or HTTPS POST to a secure endpoint with resume tokens and sequence manifests.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer configured a generic syslog bridge in Console -> Audit exports with destination = graylog-prod.novabank.example:6514 (TLS).
logs:
Excerpt from customer ingestion failure: 
2026-03-04T18:03:11Z ERROR forwarder: missing-field=customer_email tenant=novabank-123 endpoint=graylog-prod.novabank.example:6514 seq=00000045
2026-03-04T18:04:02Z INFO forwarder: batch-sent seq=00000046 manifest=hmac:abcd...
reproduction_notes: Customer observed events arriving at destination with PII fields still present and some events dropped due to 'field-mismatch' errors. They also require per-role allowlist that strips all non-allowed fields before export; current console-level redaction is insufficient because it operates post-export in their SIEM ingestion. They asked for proof-of-delivery receipts that contain batch check-hash and HSM-attested signature, plus a resume token for ordered replay.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Aisha Patel (Reporter): Opening ticket — attaching customer questionnaire and sample log extract in Confluence link. Slack: #support-novabank thread started.
2026-03-05 - Support (Marco Chen): Acknowledged. Assigned to Marco for initial triage. Opening internal investigation and pinging infra on mTLS tunnel feasibility. Linked INT-4021 for infra work.

2026-03-06 - SRE (Leah Gomez): Investigated forwarder logs for tenant novabank-123. Found repeated 'field-mismatch' rejections originating from the exporter schema enforcement layer (exporter v1.9). Sketched hypothesis: exporter applies allowlist only at destination mapping, not at per-role evaluation. Logged findings to internal runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/Export+Schema+Enforcement.

2026-03-06 - Eng (Dom Singh): Confirmed exporter binary lacks hooks for HSM salts per-tenant. We can implement per-tenant salt retrieval via KMS/HSM API and compute redact-to-hash prior to payload serialization. Estimated patch: 3 sprints for full prod hardened release; can provide a short-term patched canary for NovaBank in 5 business days.

2026-03-06 - Support (Marco Chen): Proposed interim workaround: enable console-level 'pre-export transformation' to drop all fields except the minimal allowlist NovaBank provided and send that to their Graylog. This removes PII but does not provide HSM-signed receipts. Customer accepted interim but requested signed manifests as evidence before go-live.

2026-03-07 - Security (Riley Huang): We can create per-batch manifests signed by platform HSM using an ED25519 key with attestation. Will need IAM authorization from NovaBank to reference their tenant-scoped key alias if they want customer-owned keys. Documented approach and questions in Confluence QA page.

2026-03-07 - Customer (NovaBank Security Contact - Elena Morozova): Prefers Redwood signs manifests using our HSM and includes the X.509 attestation. Also requested a short answers doc for the vendor security questionnaire about key rotation, KMS separation, and replay protection. Open to canary as long as we provide 24/7 point-of-contact during test window.
investigation_notes: Hypotheses: (1) Exporter enforces schema-level allowlist at mapping time, not as per-role runtime policy. (2) Redaction to irreversible hash requires tenant-specific salt stored in KMS/HSM; exporter currently uses a global salt. Findings: found exporter v1.9 config lacks 'role-policy' hooks; observed 'missing-field' errors match a recent schema push for redaction rules. Referenced logs and PR draft: github.com/redwood-inference/audit-exporter/pull/482. Next steps: patch exporter to evaluate allowlists at request-time, integrate KMS/HSM per-tenant salt retrieval, and add manifest generation endpoint signed by HSM.
resolution: Workaround: Enabled console pre-export transform to drop customer-requested non-allowlisted fields (applied 2026-03-06 21:00 UTC). This neutralizes PII exposure for now. Medium-term fix: engineering will ship a canary build with per-role allowlist evaluation and HSM manifest signing to NovaBank by 2026-03-12. Permanent rollout planned across prod with a canary followed by a 2-week observation window. Deliverables: (1) evidence bundle (sample redacted events, per-batch signed manifests, resume tokens) exported to S3 and shared with NovaBank; (2) security questionnaire answers (attached in Confluence page). Follow-up: open INT ticket for automated audit-forwarder smoke tests (INT-4075).
postmortem_followup: Schedule: Canary to NovaBank on 2026-03-12; production rollout 2026-03-26 pending canary success. Owner: Dom Singh (Eng). QA: SRE and Security to validate attestations and replay protections. Customer comms: Support to send a formal timeline and sample evidence bundle link by 2026-03-09.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-07 - Interim transform enabled. Customer confirmed no PII seen in sample exports after transform. Engineering scoping complete; PR drafted for exporter hooks and HSM integration. Will provide signed-manifest prototype and an evidence pack to NovaBank for audit review.
